LONDON, Oct 30 : Chelsea manager Xabi Alonso said Brazilian teenager Estevao would get opportunities this season and dismissed media speculation over a January loan move for the forward ahead of Saturday's Premier League clash with Manchester United.
Spaniard Alonso has come under scrutiny over the 19-year-old's lack of playing time, with Chelsea reeling from a 2-0 home defeat by Tottenham Hotspur last week and a League Cup fourth-round exit on penalties at Liverpool on Wednesday.
Asked at a press conference on Friday if Estevao could go out on loan, Alonso said: "No discussions about that.
"The season is long and there will be moments for everyone. It's a process for the team, for Este, for myself.

"But I'm sure that in the season he'll have his games, his minutes. And we're still early in the season but he'll be there."
Estevao has only started two matches in all competitions so far this season and was an unused substitute against Liverpool.
"It's no secret that all players want to be on the pitch; they want to be playing," Alonso said.
"And when any of them haven't had enough minutes because of my decision, I have to take the responsibility for that, that they are not as happy as they could be."
Fifth-placed Chelsea carry a lengthy injury list into Saturday's home match with under-pressure United, who are 16th.
Forward Joao Pedro and captain Reece James remain sidelined, while defender Maxence Lacroix is expected to miss a few weeks with a hamstring injury suffered in Wednesday's loss at Anfield.
"Max picked up an injury and we expect he is not going to be ready before the (November 9-17) international break," Alonso said. "He will be a few weeks out."
There was better news on midfielder Moises Caicedo, who is available despite being forced off against Liverpool with a minor issue. Goalkeeper Emi Martinez, meanwhile, could return before the international break as he recovers from a jaw injury.
"We still need to wait until next week, but there's a chance. In case he (Martinez) is ready to play, he will probably need a face mask," Alonso said.

items.title: Sun Pharma Q2 net profit falls 36% on one-time charges, revenue rises 12%
items.author: Anjali Singh
items.summary: Exceptional charges of Rs 1,268.8 crore, including a US antitrust settlement and Organon acquisition costs, weighed on profit, while India formulation sales grew 17.3 per cent ...
items.body: India’s largest drugmaker, Sun Pharmaceutical Industries, on Friday reported a 36 per cent year-on-year decline in consolidated net profit to Rs 1,988.5 crore for the second quarter of FY27, weighed down by exceptional charges. Revenue from operations rose 11.9 per cent to Rs 16,198.7 crore. The company reported exceptional charges of Rs 1,268.8 crore, comprising Rs 922.7 crore towards a settlement in a US antitrust litigation case and Rs 346.2 crore in expenses related to its proposed acquisition of Organon. Excluding exceptional items, adjusted net profit stood at Rs 3,162 crore, up 1.4 per cent year-on-year. EBITDA rose 4.8 per cent to Rs 4,743.9 crore, with margins at 29.3 per cent. The company said the margin was lower than a year earlier because the year-ago quarter had benefited from sales of generic lenalidomide, a product now facing erosion in the US. Gross margin improved to 80.8 per cent. The effective tax rate rose to 28.3 per cent from 24.7 per cent. The results were announced during market hours. Sun Pharma shares rose 0.8 per cent to close at Rs 1,778.25 on the BSE. “Our performance during the quarter was driven by strong momentum in India, Emerging Markets and Rest of World,” said Kirti Ganorkar, Managing Director. He highlighted the US approval of Ilumya for treating adults with active psoriatic arthritis and the preferred recommendation from the National Comprehensive Cancer Network (NCCN) for Unloxcyt in advanced cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma. India leads growth Formulation sales in India rose 17.3 per cent to Rs 5,552.3 crore, accounting for 34.5 per cent of consolidated sales. Sun Pharma’s market share increased to 8.6 per cent from 8.3 per cent, according to Pharmarack’s moving annual total (MAT) data for September 2026, retaining its position as the country’s largest pharmaceutical company. It ranked first by prescriptions in 12 doctor categories, according to SMSRC data. The company launched 14 new products during the quarter and 19 in the first half of FY27. US sales decline US formulation sales fell 8.2 per cent to $455 million, accounting for about 27 per cent of total sales, hurt by erosion in generic lenalidomide sales. However, sales grew 6.5 per cent sequentially, supported by five generic launches. On the earnings call, management also acknowledged a slowdown in Ilumya sales in the US. Richard Ashcroft, CEO of North America, said the causes were mixed. “I think there’s a bit of market, but frankly, part of it is execution as well, and that’s the intervention we’ve put in place,” he said. The global innovative medicines business grew 6.9 per cent to $356 million. Emerging markets formulation sales rose 7.6 per cent to $350 million, while rest-of-the-world formulation sales increased 3.1 per cent to $241 million. External active pharmaceutical ingredient (API) sales grew 13.7 per cent to Rs 488.9 crore. Organon acquisition on track On the proposed Organon acquisition, Sun Pharma said integration planning was progressing as scheduled, with regulatory approvals secured in most regions. The transaction remains on track for closure in the fourth quarter of FY27. The company indicated that acquisition-related expenses would continue to be recognised as it moves towards closing the transaction. R&D spending and guidance Research and development (R&D) expenditure for the quarter stood at Rs 778.4 crore, or 4.8 per cent of sales, with innovative R&D accounting for 32.4 per cent of the total. “These numbers are tracking lower than our intended R&D spend, but we expect the second half of the year to catch up with some of this R&D spend,” said Dilip Shanghvi, Chairman. Asked whether double-digit revenue growth in the first half would prompt an upgrade to its full-year guidance, management held firm. “We’ll stick to what guidance we have given at the beginning of the year,” the company said, referring to its high-single-digit revenue growth forecast.

items.title: 米金融政策の方向性は「明快」、問題はペース＝リッチモンド連銀総裁
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Howard Schneider

[ワシントン ３０日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Howard Schneider

[ワシントン ３０日 ロイター] - 米リッチモンド地区連銀のバーキン総裁は３０日、インフレ率が高く経済が堅調な中、金融政策の方向性は「明確」だが、今後利上げを進めるペースは未確定との認識を示した。 

バーキン総裁はシリウスＸＭの番組「ビジネス・ブリーフィング」で、ＦＲＢが再び利上げする必要があるかどうかを問われ、「インフレは高く、需要は堅調で、失業率は比較的低い。だから、方向性はかなり単純明快だと思う」と応じた。

その上で「問われるのは、ペースだ。われわれは段階的なアプローチを示唆した。カーブにそれほど遅れておらず、見極める時間を確保したい場合には、段階的な対応が理にかなう」と述べた。

バーキン総裁は現時点では段階的なアプローチが適切だと指摘。多くのコスト圧力が米企業を襲っているとし、数年にわたるインフレ高進という状況の中で、企業が値上げの必要性を主張しやすくなっていると語った。

個人消費の底堅さは、所得が比較的横ばいである点を踏まえると驚きだと指摘した。

ＡＩ（人工知能）については、関連する投資の急増がサプライチェーンを圧迫しており、それがインフレを招いているとも述べた。ＡＩ投資は需要側のインフレをもたらしており、これはＦＲＢが抑制できる類いのものだと語った。

バーキン総裁によると、企業経営者らの話では需要は依然として堅調で、弱さが見られるのは非営利部門と住宅部門のみだという。企業はコスト圧力が広範囲に及んでいると話しており、そのコストを価格に転嫁する計画を立てているとした。

items.title: Economic growth stalled again in August, StatCan says
items.author: The Canadian Press
items.summary: Statistics Canada says the economy stalled for a second month in a row in August, and early estimates suggest growth declined in September.
items.body: Canada’s economy stalled for a second month in a row in August and may be set for a decline in September, Statistics Canada said Friday. StatCan said real gross domestic product was essentially unchanged in August, falling short of economists’ calls and the agency’s own early expectations for a gain of 0.2 per cent. Wholesale trade fell 1.4 per cent in the month as most subsectors contracted. StatCan said motor vehicle and vehicle parts wholesalers faced their first decline in seven months amid lower vehicle imports and weaker manufacturing activity in the subsector. Work to prepare the 2026 census was also winding down in the month, driving widespread contractions in public administration. Strength in mining and quarrying was more than offset by a decline in oil and gas extraction, StatCan said. Oil sands extraction was the biggest drag on growth due to maintenance at some facilities in northern Alberta. Maintenance outages at nuclear power plants in Ontario and New Brunswick also dragged down the utilities industry in August. Retail trade was among the bright spots in the month, posting 1.2 per cent growth and more than making up for a decline in July. Manufacturing rose for the fifth time in seven months, and the transportation and warehousing industry and finance and insurance sector also saw gains in August. StatCan’s early estimates for September suggest real GDP declined 0.1 per cent, driven by losses in manufacturing and mining, quarrying and oil and gas extraction. Despite flat growth in July and August and signs of a decline in September, StatCan’s flash estimates still see real GDP expanding 1.3 per cent on an annualized basis in the third quarter, a slowdown from 3.3 per cent growth in the second quarter. Because the economy was coming off such a robust month in June, it provided a strong starting point for the third quarter. As a result, despite weakened activity over the three-month period, it still produces positive annualized growth when compared to the second quarter’s average. StatCan will provide its official quarterly estimates for the third quarter next month when it reports the September GDP figures. BMO chief economist Doug Porter said in a note to clients Friday that some of the weakness last quarter might be overstated, particularly as it relates to census-related slowdowns. “Still, with the trade tiff still flaring, housing struggling, and recent employment figures concerning, it certainly appears that growth has run into some pretty serious headwinds of late,” he said. The latest economic data comes two days after the Bank of Canada raised its benchmark interest rate by a quarter point to 2.5 per cent, the first hike in more than three years. Officials at the central bank argued that rate hikes were warranted to get ahead of looming inflation risks. Governor Tiff Macklem pointed to signs of resilience in the Canadian economy over the spring in justifying the decision. The central bank also revised up its expectations for growth on Wednesday. Monetary policymakers are expecting growth in the third quarter ended up at two per cent on an annualized basis, up from 1.5 per cent in its July forecasts. Many economists weighing in Friday argued the Bank of Canada’s somewhat rosier projections are at risk after StatCan data suggested middling growth in the third quarter. BMO, which had been in line with the central bank’s call for two per cent growth, trimmed its outlook to 1.5 per cent after Friday’s surprise. Andrew Grantham, senior economist at CIBC, said in a note that the data suggested the economy “was already struggling for momentum even before this week’s interest rate hike.” A slower-than-expected economy could help relieve inflationary pressures and reduce the need for additional rate hikes, he added. The weak GDP results support a pause from the Bank of Canada at its final rate decision of the year in December, Grantham said, though he noted there’s plenty of additional economic data to come before that meeting. --- Craig Lord, The Canadian Press This report by The Canadian Press was first published Oct. 30, 2026.

items.author: The Canadian Press
items.summary: Cameco Corp. reported a third-quarter profit attributable to equity holders of $43 million as its revenue edged up compared with a year ago.
items.body: SASKATOON — Cameco Corp. reported a third-quarter profit attributable to equity holders of $43 million as its revenue edged up compared with a year ago. The uranium miner says the profit amounted to 10 cents per diluted share for the quarter ended Sept. 30 compared with a break even result in the same quarter last year. Revenue totalled $619 million for the quarter, up from $615 million a year ago. On an adjusted basis, Cameco reported a loss of $2 million or zero cents per diluted share compared with an adjusted profit of $32 million or seven cents per diluted share a year earlier. Cameco says its results for the quarter and first nine months of the year were generally lower than in 2025, primarily due to lower equity earnings from its investment in Westinghouse, as well as lower sales volumes and higher average unit cost of sales. The company says those factors were partially offset by higher realized prices. --- This report by The Canadian Press was first published Oct. 30, 2026.

ANKARA, Oct 30 : Former Liverpool forward Dirk Kuyt will remain as manager of Fenerbahce until the next international break and will be in the dugout when his old club visit Istanbul in the Champions League next week.
The Turkish club said their board had decided to hand Kuyt responsibility for the first team on an interim basis while they search for a permanent head coach.
"The committee established by our board will carry out the work to appoint our new head coach, and the process will be accelerated," Fenerbahce said in a statement.
Dutchman Kuyt, 46, took over from Ismail Kartal, who resigned following Monday's 2-1 derby defeat by Galatasaray.
The former Netherlands international spent six seasons at Liverpool between 2006 and 2012 before joining Fenerbahce, where he won the Turkish league title in 2014.

Source: Reuters

FAST

WASHINGTON, Oct 30 : While dinosaurs ate a lot of different things, including each other, fruit long seemed to have been absent from their menu. But scientists now have found fossils of a turkey-sized and toothless dinosaur possessing a parrot-like head that exhibited multiple adaptations for a specialized fruit diet.
This first-known frugivorous dinosaur, named Infernogallus jamesi, lived about 66 million years ago during the Cretaceous Period at the twilight of the age of dinosaurs and displayed traits on its beak and jaws for mashing soft food like fruit. It is known from fossils unearthed in Montana and North Dakota.
The name Infernogallus means "hell chicken," a nod to its bird-like appearance and the fact that its fossils were found in the Hell Creek rock formation, which spans the US states of Montana, North Dakota, South Dakota and Wyoming and has yielded the remains of some of the most famous dinosaurs.
It would have eaten fruit and other soft plants in the subtropical coastal floodplain ecosystem it shared with the likes of apex predator Tyrannosaurus, three-horned herbivore Triceratops and tank-like armored plant-eater Ankylosaurus.

Infernogallus was about 5 feet (1.5 meters) long and weighed around 25 pounds (11.3 kg). While the fossils — one nearly complete skeleton and isolated bones from a jaw and palate — did not reveal feathers, the researchers believe Infernogallus was covered in them, based on fossils of close relatives.
It belonged to a group called theropods that includes T. rex and all the meat-eating dinosaurs, as well as some that took to eating plants and the entire bird lineage.
"This definitely expands the range of lifestyles we thought dinosaurs had, and it shows how adaptable theropods were," said paleontologist Greg Funston of Stony Brook University in New York, lead author of the research published in the journal Nature Communications.
Fruits are the reproductive structures of angiosperms, also called flowering plants. Angiosperms first appeared earlier in the Cretaceous, around 130 to 140 million years ago, and subsequently took over landscapes previously dominated by plants called gymnosperms like conifers and ginkgoes.
Infernogallus shows that some dinosaurs may have had a close ecological relationship with flowering plants.
"It has been proposed before that some groups of dinosaurs ate fruits, but there was never evidence to back it up," said study co-author Thomas Dudgeon, a postdoctoral researcher at the Royal Ontario Museum in Toronto.
"The discovery of Infernogallus shows that dinosaur diets were likely far more diverse than we previously thought. Prior to this discovery, there was a bit of a mystery in dinosaur evolution. The evolution of flowering plants introduced a brand-new food source that undoubtedly had consequences for the animals living alongside them," Dudgeon said.
The fruit available for Infernogallus may have included various berries as well as drupes, a broad category that today includes types with a central pit like peaches and cherries as well as others like mangoes and olives.
THREE KEY FEATURES
Infernogallus showed a range of features indicating a frugivorous diet. The three most important, Funston said, were the organization of jaw muscles that powered back-and-forth chewing motions, a mobile joint that enabled the jaw to slide forward, and a series of ridges and grooves on the beak to help mash and shear soft plants like fruits.
"We see these features separately in birds and turtles today that eat soft foods, like the fig-eating vulturine parrot or green sea turtles that chew soft sea grass. But no living animal has all three adaptations, showing just how specialized Infernogallus was," Funston said.
Infernogallus also shows how adaptable beaks are compared to teeth.
"Once you've lost your teeth and developed a beak instead, the range of foods available dramatically increases, including plants, as long as you have some way to digest them," Funston said.
Most herbivorous theropods used stomach stones called gastroliths to grind food. But Infernogallus and other members of a lineage called caenagnathids chewed their food instead.
Fruit-eating animals play an important role for angiosperms by dispersing seeds.
"Mammals and birds would probably also have eaten fruit, but they didn't show the same kinds of specializations for a frugivorous diet that Infernogallus does, so it might have been a less important resource for them. Mammals and birds also were quite small in the Cretaceous, so it's unlikely that they were spreading very large seeds, or that they were spreading them big distances," Funston said.
"We know that these big-seeded fruits were proliferating and spreading, and it seems like caenagnathids could have fit this role — although we feel more evidence is needed before drawing that link confidently," Funston said.

Source: Reuters

Mammals and birds also were quite small in the Cretaceous, so it's unlikely that they were spreading very large seeds, or that they were spreading them big distances," Funston said.
"We know that these big-seeded fruits were proliferating and spreading, and it seems like caenagnathids could have fit this role — although we feel more evidence is needed before drawing that link confidently," Funston said.

items.title: Bitcoin cae hasta US$76.300 mientras el hackeo de Binance reaviva dudas sobre la seguridad cripto
items.author: Suvashree Ghosh
items.summary: La criptomoneda original cayó hasta un 3,1% el viernes, llegando a cotizar a tan solo US$76.300. Otros tokens, incluidos algunos afectados por la brecha de seguridad, también sufrieron caídas.
items.body: Bloomberg — El bitcoin cayó por debajo de los US$77.000 por primera vez en más de un mes, profundizando la venta masiva después de que Binance Holdings revelara un hackeo sin precedentes que sacudió a la industria de las criptomonedas y reavivó las dudas sobre la seguridad de los activos de los clientes, incluso en la mayor plataforma de intercambio de activos digitales del mundo. La criptomoneda original cayó hasta un 3,1% el viernes, llegando a cotizar a tan solo US$76.300. Otros tokens, incluidos algunos afectados por la brecha de seguridad, también sufrieron caídas. El token BNB de Binance ha bajado aproximadamente un 5% en las últimas 24 horas, situándose en torno a los US$700. Ver más: Binance estima en US$6.300 millones el mayor hackeo de la historia de las criptomonedas La brecha de seguridad, en la que los atacantes sustrajeron más de US$6 mil millones, es el mayor robo de criptomonedas registrado hasta la fecha y supone otro duro golpe para un sector que lleva años intentando deshacerse de su reputación de hackeos, estafas y fallos en las plataformas de intercambio. Además, pone en entredicho las propias medidas de seguridad de Binance, al plantear interrogantes sobre cómo una plataforma de intercambio de su tamaño —con más de US$135 mil millones en activos— pudo sucumbir a una brecha de tal magnitud. Binance anunció el viernes que ha reservado US$6.340 millones de los fondos de la compañía a raíz del incidente. “El mercado de criptomonedas en general ya mostraba una tendencia bajista, por lo que la caída se extendió tan rápidamente”, afirmó Jeff Ko, analista jefe de ViaBTC. Añadió que Binance puede absorber las pérdidas. El bitcoin y otros tokens ya se encontraban bajo presión esta semana, debido a factores macroeconómicos más amplios que lastraban el mercado. El bitcoin se mantuvo en torno a los US$80.000 durante gran parte de la semana. Sin embargo, el vencimiento el viernes de opciones por valor de US$11.000 millones en la plataforma Deribit influyó en el mercado, lo que contribuyó a la aversión generalizada al riesgo. Según datos de Coinglass, en un periodo de 24 horas se esfumaron aproximadamente US$1.300 millones en posiciones alcistas sobre criptomonedas. Ver más: Binance suspende depósitos y retiros tras presunto hackeo que deja más de US$2.500 millones congelados “La desventaja es que la serie de duros golpes que ha sufrido la infraestructura de criptomonedas en los últimos meses podría disuadir a los nuevos participantes del mercado”, afirmó Noelle Acheson, autora del boletín informativo Crypto is Macro Now . “Hemos visto que la autocustodia no es segura, la custodia en las plataformas de intercambio tampoco, y la avalancha de ataques de bots de IA contra la seguridad en todas las aplicaciones en línea va a generar aún más nerviosismo”. Sin embargo, el aspecto positivo es que “cada nueva brecha de seguridad hace que la seguridad sea más sólida”, añadió. Lea más en Bloomberg.com

Oct 30 : Tencent-backed Kuaishou Technology said on Friday that its unit Beijing Kling has completed a fundraising round of about 19.8 billion yuan ($2.98 billion).
The short-video platform operator will hold two-thirds of the equity and 52.45 per cent of voting rights in the Kling AI maker through its Lucky Labs holding vehicle.
• The fundraise comes after a $2.8 billion raise in July, which drew investors like Alibaba and Tencent, when Kling was valued at $15 billion pre-money
• Kuaishou did not reveal how Kling would use the proceeds

items.title: S&P 500 cae arrastrado por Intel y Amazon, mientras el bitcoin retrocede tras hackeo a Binance
items.author: Carlos Rodríguez Salcedo
items.summary: Los resultados de Amazon e Intel profundizan las dudas sobre el gasto en inteligencia artificial, mientras un ataque contra Binance y el riesgo de una escalada militar con Irán aumentan la aversión al ...
items.body: Bloomberg Línea — Wall Street abre este viernes con presión sobre las acciones tecnológicas, después de que los resultados de Amazon ( AMZN ) e Intel ( INTC ) profundizaran las dudas sobre el retorno de las inversiones en inteligencia artificial (IA). Ver más: Cuatro escenarios para Wall Street y estrategias de inversión hasta junio de 2027, según UBS El retroceso se produce después de que Alphabet ( GOOGL ) perdiera 13% el jueves, su mayor caída histórica. Los inversionistas cuestionan el gasto de las grandes tecnológicas ante señales de desaceleración en sus negocios tradicionales. El S&P 500 pierde 1,22%, mientras el Nasdaq cede 2,32%. El Dow Jones Industrial retrocede 0,31%. La presión también alcanza a los bonos corporativos vinculados con la IA, mientras el petróleo sube por el riesgo de nuevos ataques estadounidenses contra Irán. En contraste, la demanda de refugio favorece a los bonos del Tesoro y al franco suizo. Así se ha comportado las acciones de Intel. Símbolo: INTC:UN. Clase de activo: crypto. Amazon registraba una caída cercana a 7%, tras anunciar inversiones de capital superiores a las previstas y el crecimiento más lento de su negocio de comercio electrónico en tres años, pese al sólido desempeño de su división de nube. Intel, por su parte, perdía alrededor de 26%, después de presentar una previsión de ingresos inferior a las estimaciones. La compañía enfrenta una demanda débil de procesadores para computadores y dificultades de suministro en centros de datos. La presión se extendía a Advanced Micro Devices ( AMD ), con una caída de 9,7%, y Nvidia ( NVDA ), que retrocedía 2,99%. Super Micro Computer ( SMCI ), Bloom Energy ( BE ) y CoreWeave ( CRWV ) también registraban pérdidas ante la revisión de expectativas sobre la infraestructura de IA. → Suscríbete al newsletter Línea de Mercado , una selección de Bloomberg Línea con las noticias bursátiles más destacadas del día. El mercado también evalúa el costo financiero de estas inversiones. Microsoft ( MSFT ) anunció una emisión de deuda por US$25.000 millones, mientras las grandes tecnológicas enfrentan cuestionamientos sobre una apuesta conjunta de US$750.000 millones en inteligencia artificial. “Los resultados tecnológicos han demostrado ser un obstáculo importante, pues los inversionistas se han convertido repentinamente en vigilantes del gasto de capital”, afirmó Jai Malhi, estratega sénior de renta variable de Vanda Research. Pese al deterioro tecnológico, la corrección no afecta de manera uniforme al mercado. Más de 400 compañías del S&P 500 avanzaron el jueves, reflejo de una rotación hacia sectores defensivos que podría continuar durante la sesión. La aversión al riesgo se intensificó tras un ataque informático contra Binance que provocó el robo de US$6.300 millones, el mayor registrado en la industria de criptomonedas. La plataforma suspendió los retiros y prometió cubrir las pérdidas. Binance informó que cerca de US$3.000 millones fueron congelados en redes blockchain y reservó US$6.340 millones de recursos propios. Firmas de análisis como TRM Labs atribuyeron el ataque a un grupo vinculado con Corea del Norte. El bitcoin ( XBTUSD ) cayó hasta US$76.300, su nivel más bajo en más de un mes, antes de recuperarse hacia US$77.500. La presión coincidió con el vencimiento de opciones por US$11.000 millones y liquidaciones de posiciones alcistas por aproximadamente US$1.300 millones. Así se ha comportado el precio del bitcoin. Símbolo: XBTUSD:CUR. Clase de activo: crypto. El oro descendía 1,2%, hasta US$3.971,53 por onza, afectado por las expectativas de tasas elevadas y posibles ventas para cubrir pérdidas bursátiles. Los operadores asignan una probabilidad de 70% a un aumento de tasas de la Reserva Federal en diciembre. La plata retrocedía 3,3%, hasta US$50,42 por onza, mientras el cobre perdía 0,9%, hasta US$14.227 por tonelada. Este último enfrenta presión por las dudas sobre el crecimiento, aunque persisten restricciones de oferta e inventarios reducidos en China. En el mercado de deuda, los rendimientos de los bonos del Tesoro extendían sus descensos, tras acumular una caída cercana a 40 puntos básicos durante octubre. El yen también se fortaleció después de que el Banco de Japón mantuviera sus tasas sin cambios. Ver más: Petróleo, oro y café: Banco Mundial anticipa un giro en los precios de materias primas en 2027 En materias primas, el Brent avanzaba 2,5%, hasta US$117,75 por barril, ante informes de que un alto comandante estadounidense presentó al presidente Donald Trump opciones militares contra Irán. El WTI ganaba 2,2%, hasta US$104,27. La incertidumbre aumentó después de dos ataques contra petroleros cerca del estrecho de Ormuz. Aunque el tránsito de crudo por esa ruta se ha recuperado parcialmente, las reservas ajustadas y las interrupciones en refinerías rusas mantienen la presión sobre la oferta. Las elecciones legislativas estadounidenses de la próxima semana representan otro foco de atención. En Israel, el bloque de Benjamin Netanyahu obtuvo 53 escaños, insuficientes para alcanzar una mayoría, lo que prolonga la incertidumbre regional. El encarecimiento energético favoreció a ExxonMobil ( XOM ), Chevron ( CVX ), BP ( BP ), Shell ( SHEL ) y TotalEnergies ( TTE ), que reportaron beneficios ajustados conjuntos de US$56.300 millones en el tercer trimestre. Exxon obtuvo US$9.050 millones en refinación y Chevron, US$4.930 millones. El gas europeo también avanzaba 5,3%, hasta €103,16 por megavatio hora, ante el riesgo de mayores interrupciones de suministro. Los inventarios europeos se encuentran al 75% de su capacidad, mientras Alemania registra niveles inferiores al 62%. La jornada estará marcada por la evolución de las pérdidas tecnológicas, la respuesta del mercado al ataque contra Binance y las tensiones con Irán, mientras los inversionistas ajustan sus posiciones antes de las elecciones estadounidenses de la próxima semana. Ver más: El desplome de la bolsa de Brasil por Lula deja un contagio limitado en América Latina El dólar retrocede este viernes a nivel global, aunque mantiene buena parte de las ganancias acumuladas durante octubre, cuando llegó a su nivel más alto desde mayo de 2025. La atención del mercado se concentra en las elecciones legislativas estadounidenses del 3 de noviembre y en las perspectivas de nuevas alzas de tasas de interés por parte de la Fed. Daniel Tobón, estratega de Citi ( C ), señaló a Bloomberg que los antecedentes electorales apuntan a una depreciación del dólar después de los comicios, especialmente si el resultado deja un Congreso dividido. En medio de ese contexto, las monedas de América Latina caen en su mayoría. El real brasileño ( USDBRL ), el peso chileno ( USDCLP ), el mexicano ( USDMXN ) y el colombiano ( USDCOP ) caen, mientras el peso argentino ( USDARS ) avanza. - Bayer ganó un juicio en EE.UU. por Roundup, reforzando su estrategia para reducir los litigios heredados de Monsanto, que ya le han costado más de US$11.000 millones. La empresa aún enfrenta unos 65.000 casos y espera la decisión final sobre un acuerdo de US$7.250 millones para resolver la mayoría de las demandas. - AstraZeneca ( AZN ) superó expectativas en el tercer trimestre con ganancias ajustadas de US$2,79 por acción, impulsadas por oncología, cuyas ventas crecieron 17%. La farmacéutica prevé ahorrar US$1.500 millones anuales para reinvertir en nuevos fármacos. Así se han comportado las acciones de Astrazeneca. Símbolo: AZN:UN. Clase de activo: equity. - Mondelez ( MDLZ ) comprará una participación mayoritaria en Undercover Snacks para ampliar su oferta de productos saludables. La dueña de Oreo registró ingresos trimestrales de US$9.970 millones y mantuvo sus previsiones anuales. - Chevron ( CVX ) mantiene su calendario para suministrar energía con gas natural a un centro de datos de Microsoft ( MSFT ) en Texas, pese a la suspensión temporal de permisos estatales. La compañía prevé iniciar el suministro en 2028 y aumentar la capacidad hasta 2031, mientras avanza en permisos, ingeniería y financiación del proyecto.

items.body:
[ベルリン ３０日 ロイター] - ドイツ連邦統計庁が３０日発表した１０月の消費者物価指数（ＣＰＩ）速報値は、欧州連合（ＥＵ）基準（ＨＩＣＰ）で前年比２．８％上昇した。伸びは９月（３．３％上昇）から鈍化し、ロイターがまとめたアナリスト予想（３．１％上昇）も下回った。

エネルギー価格の上昇率が１２．２％と、９月の１４．９％から鈍化したことが背景にある。１０月初めに導入され、年末まで維持される予定の燃料税軽減策が、燃料価格の緩やかな下落につながっている。    

価格変動の大きいエネルギーと食品を除いたコアインフレ率は２．１％上昇と、９月の２．４％上昇から伸びが鈍化した。 

ユーロ圏の１０月インフレ率は１１月４日に発表される。ロイター調査によるエコノミスト予想では、前月の３．８％から３．９％に小幅加速する見通し。

items.title: U.S. futures fall as Amazon, Intel and Alphabet weigh on Wall Street
items.author: The Associated Press
items.summary: U.S. futures are falling Friday as technology companies such as Amazon, Intel and Alphabet all tumble lower, pressuring Wall Street.
items.body: NEW YORK — A sell-off for tech stocks is barreling into Friday and forcing the U.S. market down again, with Amazon and Intel leading the way this time. The S&P 500 fell 1.3 per cent and was on track to erase its gain for October, even though it set its all-time high during the month. The weakness for technology stocks dragged the Nasdaq composite down 2.5 per cent, as of 9:35 a.m. Eastern time, though the rest of the market was holding up better for a second straight day. The Dow Jones Industrial Average fell a more modest 0.3 per cent, or 173 points. Amazon was one of the heaviest weights on the market and dropped 4.4 per cent after reporting a weaker profit for the summer than analysts expected. Potentially more concerning for investors was Amazon’s reporting that it burned through US$42.4 billion of cash over the prior 12 months, according to a measure called free cash flow. It spent US$94.8 billion on property and equipment, primarily through investments in artificial-intelligence technology. A day earlier, Alphabet’s stock dropped more than 12 per cent to its worst day on record after telling investors that it burned through more cash during the summer than the spring because of similar, mammoth investments in AI. Worries are rising about whether all those hundreds of billions of dollars will produce enough profit and productivity to make the investment worth it. At the same time, stocks of computer chip companies and other winners from the frenzy to build AI data centers have come under pressure on concerns that high interest rates may slow the further build out of data centers. Intel tumbled 28.8 per cent and is flirting with its worst day since 1974, even though the chipmaker reported a stronger profit for the latest quarter than analysts expected. It gave a forecast for profit in the final three months of this year that fell far short of analysts’ expectations. CEO Lip-Bu Tan said the personal-computer industry continues to feel pressure, which hurts demand for Intel’s CPUs. In the cryptocurrency industry, meanwhile, stocks tumbled following a hack on the world’s biggest crypto exchange. The price of bitcoin fell toward US$77,000 from more than US$86,000 earlier this month, and a U.S.-based blockchain intelligence firm said a North Korean unit was likely behind the attack that impacted more than US$6 billion worth of crypto at Binance. Coinbase Global fell 12.7 per cent even though it reported stronger results for the latest quarter than analysts expected. Strategy, which says it owns about 4 per cent of the total supply of bitcoin, fell 11.6 per cent. It also reported a stronger profit for the latest quarter than analysts expected, while saying its chief financial officer will resign next week for personal reasons. Such losses overshadowed strength for the rest of Wall Street, where many stocks rallied after reporting stronger profits for the summer than analysts expected. The market is heading toward a second straight day where the majority of stocks in the S&P 500 rises but get overwhelmed by losses for larger, more influential Big Tech stocks. Mondelez International climbed 4.6 per cent after the company behind Oreo cookies and Ritz crackers reported stronger-than-expected growth. Colgate-Palmolive rose 4.7 per cent after higher prices for its products around much of the world helped it deliver better revenue and profit than analysts expected. Exxon Mobil rose 2.3 per cent, and Chevron added 1.6 per cent after the oil giants both reported stronger profit for the summer than analysts expected. Starbucks had a more muted move following its own better-than-expected profit report and slipped 0.2 per cent. Its revenue for the quarter fell short of analysts’ expectations. Expectations are high broadly for U.S. companies’ ability to make bigger profits, even though people around the world are feeling discouraged about high inflation and high fuel prices. Such expectations are what drove the S&P 500 to its record earlier this month. In the bond market, Treasury yields eased in a signal that investors were buying U.S. government bonds in search of something safer to own. The yield on the 10-year Treasury fell to 4.93 per cent from 4.98 per cent late Thursday and from more than 5.30 per cent earlier this month. U.S. Treasury yields fell even though oil prices bounced higher, something that pushes upward on inflation and usually drives yields higher. The price for a barrel of Brent crude oil rose 2 per cent to US$113.04. It’s near the high end of its range since the war with Iran sent oil prices and inflation higher. In stock markets abroad, indexes were mixed in Europe following sharper action in Asia. South Korea’s Kospi dropped 3.5 per cent as worries about AI hit its tech-heavy market, while the Hang Seng in Hong Kong climbed 1.5 per cent. Japan’s Nikkei 225 fell 2.1 per cent after the Bank of Japan decided to keep interest rates steady, echoing moves made earlier in the week by the Federal Reserve and the European Central Bank. ___ Stan Choe, The Associated Press AP Business Writers Yuri Kageyama and Michelle Chapman contributed to this report.

PARIS, Oct 30 : France's national sports institute INSEP has expelled five teenage basketball players following incidents involving physical violence at its Paris boarding facility, it said on Friday.
INSEP had initially suspended 10 players and launched an internal investigation last month after younger players were subjected to acts described as "hazing" by older teammates.
"After reviewing the facts and individual responsibilities, five athletes have been permanently expelled from the institution," INSEP said in a statement.
"For the other five, the sanctions imposed make it possible to consider their reinstatement at INSEP in the short or medium term, subject to educational measures."
Fabien Canu, INSEP's director general, said the decisions taken "make clear that no form of humiliation, harassment, violence or hazing will be tolerated within our institution".

Source: Reuters

items.title: Costos laborales en EE.UU. crecieron 3,4% anual y apuntan a menores presiones inflacionarias
items.author: Jeffrey Sparshott
items.summary: El índice de costos laborales, que registra las variaciones en salarios y beneficios, aumentó un 3,4% en los 12 meses que finalizaron en septiembre, según cifras publicadas el viernes por la Oficina d ...
items.body: Bloomberg — El crecimiento de los costos laborales en Estados Unidos se mantuvo estable en el tercer trimestre, lo que sugiere que el mercado laboral no está contribuyendo a presiones inflacionarias más amplias. El índice de costos laborales, que registra las variaciones en salarios y beneficios, aumentó un 3,4% en los 12 meses que finalizaron en septiembre, según cifras publicadas el viernes por la Oficina de Estadísticas Laborales. Ajustados por la inflación, los costos de compensación disminuyeron un 0,4%. Trimestralmente, el indicador subió un 0,8%. Ver más: Economía de EE.UU. creció 3,4% en el tercer trimestre, su mayor avance en un año El mercado laboral se ha mantenido en general estable este año, con pocos despidos y una contratación moderada. Sin embargo, muchos trabajadores han tenido dificultades para hacer frente al aumento de los precios. “El aumento del empleo ha seguido el ritmo de la población activa, y la tasa de desempleo apenas ha variado. No obstante, la inflación sigue siendo elevada”, declaró el miércoles el presidente de la Reserva Federal, Kevin Warsh, después de que el banco central decidiera mantener las tasas de interés sin cambios. El informe del ECI del viernes reveló que el crecimiento de los sueldos y salarios de los trabajadores civiles se redujo ligeramente hasta el 0,7% en los tres meses hasta septiembre, y hasta el 3,1% respecto al año anterior —el nivel más bajo desde 2021—. Ajustados a la inflación, los salarios descendieron un 0,6% en los 12 meses hasta septiembre. Los costos para las prestaciones sanitarias de los empleadores del sector privado aumentaron un 6,4% en el año que finalizó en septiembre, el nivel más alto desde finales de 2025. La próxima semana, la Oficina de Estadísticas Laborales (BLS) publicará su informe de empleo de octubre, que ofrecerá una nueva perspectiva sobre la contratación y los salarios en todo Estados Unidos. Oct 30 : Former England fast bowler James Anderson has said he was shocked when Lancashire chose not to renew his contract, ending a 25-year association with his home county.
The 44-year-old, England's leading test wicket taker with 704 victims in 188 matches, retired from international duty in 2024.
"I was being told they thought the best way for the team to move forward was without me. I was quite shocked. It was quite brief," Anderson told the BBC Tailenders podcast on Friday.
"I wanted to see my career out with Lancs (Lancashire). I don't know if my career is done, we'll have to wait and see, but it would be nice at some point if someone would let me retire."

items.title: Sebi eases FPI compliance, extends KYC review period from December 1
items.author: Khushboo Tiwari
items.summary: Sebi has extended KYC review intervals for certain foreign portfolio investors to two or eight years and removed a separate disclosure requirement, effective December 1 ...
items.body: The Securities and Exchange Board of India (Sebi) on Friday rationalised the periodicity of know-your-customer (KYC) reviews for foreign portfolio investors (FPIs), as part of measures to reduce repetitive compliance requirements. According to the regulator, the revised framework increases the periodicity from one year to two years, and from three years to eight years, for specified categories of FPIs. The revised framework will come into effect from December 1. The regulator also announced that it would be doing away with the separate requirement for FPIs, other than those investing only in government securities, to intimate changes in previously submitted information or provide a no-change declaration at the time of continuation of registration. Under the revised norms, the frequency of KYC review will depend on the jurisdiction, category and regulated status of the FPI. For FPIs in non-high-risk jurisdictions, the review period will be eight years for Category-I investors. For Category-II investors, regulated entities will be subject to review every eight years, while others will have to undergo it every two years. For Category-I FPIs in high-risk jurisdictions, the review will be required every eight years for those registered under Regulation 5(a)(i) (government and government-related investors), and every two years for others. For Category-II FPIs in high-risk jurisdictions, the review will be every two years. The periodicity applicable to FPIs investing only in government securities (GS-FPIs) and single window automatic and generalised access for trusted foreign investors (SWAGAT-FI) FPIs will remain unchanged.  For SWAGAT-FI FPIs, the KYC review period will continue to be 10 years. For GS-FPIs, the review will continue to follow the periodicity applicable to their respective bank accounts, as prescribed by the Reserve Bank of India (RBI). Sebi has also modified the provisions on continuation of registration. FPIs wishing to continue their registration for the subsequent block of three years will have to pay the fees to their designated depository participant (DDP). For SWAGAT-FI FPIs, the block is 10 years. The fees must be paid at least 15 days before the existing validity expires, to facilitate a smooth continuation process. Depositories, custodians and DDPs have been asked to make the necessary changes in their systems and processes and bring them to the notice of the FPIs concerned. The regulator said the measure seeks to rationalise requirements of a similar nature, reduce repetitive compliance and ease the compliance burden on FPIs. The move is part of its broader effort to reduce procedural requirements and provide a seamless, transparent and investor-friendly environment for FPIs, it said.

Oct 30 : World number one Elena Rybakina withdrew from the Pan Pacific Open quarter-finals on Friday due to a neck injury, sending Canada's Leylah Fernandez through to the last four via walkover.
• "Unfortunately, I’ve been experiencing inflammation and pain in my neck, which has been affecting my ability to play at my best," the Kazakh said in a statement on the WTA website.
• Rybakina secured the year-end number one ranking after beating compatriot Yulia Putintseva in the second round.
• Fernandez will face Russia's Kamilla Rakhimova for a place in the final.
• Rybakina is expected to compete at next month's season-ending WTA Finals in Indian Wells, California.

FRANKFURT, Oct 30 : The Court of Arbitration for Sport (CAS) ruled on Friday that Russian teams can compete in next year's men's and women's world championships, overturning International Ice Hockey Federation (IIHF) decisions to exclude them from its competitions.
CAS upheld appeals lodged by the Russian Ice Hockey Federation against the IIHF barring its teams from participating in events during the 2026-27 season.
The Lausanne-based court said the IIHF had not presented sufficient evidence to justify its assessment that security concerns required Russia's continued exclusion from its competitions.
The first tournament affected by the ruling is the world junior championship in Canada, which begins on December 26.

CAS said the ruling did not address issues such as whether Russian teams should compete under a neutral flag and without national symbols, as athletes from the country have done in other sports.
RUSSIA WELCOMES RULING
The IIHF has excluded Russia, which has won five IIHF world titles as an independent nation, from most international ice hockey competitions since 2022 following the country's invasion of Ukraine.
"Russia is returning to world hockey. This place rightfully belongs to us, and discrimination in hockey has been brought to an end," Sports Minister Mikhail Degtyarev told state television channel Vesti.
The IIHF said it was disappointed by the outcome.
"The IIHF disagrees with this aspect of the ruling and maintains that its decisions were necessary to protect the safety and security of all participants and safeguard the integrity of its competitions," the federation said.
Germany, host of the men's world championship in May, said the ruling had significant implications for the tournament.
"Our position remains unchanged: We reject the return of Russian national teams to international ice hockey tournaments," German Ice Hockey Federation chairman Frank H. Lutz said.
The Czech Ice Hockey Association, whose country is hosting the women's Under-18 world championship in January, said it was "very unpleasantly surprised" by the decision.
"The current position of Czech Hockey does not change with the CAS decision," Czech Hockey General Secretary Jan Cerny said.
Other European nations including Sweden, Finland and Austria also criticised the ruling.
"Our position is that Russia cannot participate in international championships in the current situation," Swedish Ice Hockey Association chairman Anders Larsson said.

Source: Reuters

FAST

BENGALURU, Oct 30 : Alexander Zverev, who spent years waiting for his moment to reach the summit of his sport only for a new golden generation to surge past him, has claimed the honour that long eluded him by climbing to the top of the world rankings.
Zverev had long been one of the brightest talents to emerge in the 2010s, but his path, like that of his peers, was largely blocked by the enduring dominance of Roger Federer, Rafa Nadal, Novak Djokovic and Andy Murray.
Despite winning two ATP Finals titles on either side of an Olympic gold medal in 2021, Zverev struggled to make a similar impact at the Grand Slams as Jannik Sinner and Carlos Alcaraz formed a new roadblock  when the greats began to decline.
All that changed this year, however, as Zverev, 29, capitalised on injuries to his major rivals and found another level to claim the French Open and US Open titles.

"It's incredibly special," said Zverev, who will take over from Sinner on Monday and become the 30th man to top the world rankings since they were introduced in 1973. "It's something I've worked towards for years and you have to show great tennis the whole year to be in this position."
Zverev will become only the second world number one, after Daniil Medvedev, from the crop of players now largely in their late 20s and early 30s who emerged during the "Big Four" era but never displaced them.
ANKLE INJURY
The summit had been within Zverev's reach before, but a serious ankle injury at the 2022 French Open derailed his push, and Grand Slam success continued to elude him on his return as Sinner and Alcaraz accumulated 12 majors between them.
With Alcaraz's season stalled by a wrist injury and Sinner suffering a knee injury, Zverev's consistency and durability were decisive this year as he triumphed at Roland Garros and Flushing Meadows and reached the Wimbledon final.
"I've had a lot of difficult moments in my career: the lost Grand Slam finals, the injury in 2022," Zverev added.
"But I always somehow kept believing, kept going. This year I also took the step of changing my game a little and rebuilding it, at 29. The way this season has gone is a dream."
Zverev's path to the top has also included turbulence away from the court, with allegations of domestic abuse which he has repeatedly denied.
A German court closed a case involving his former partner Brenda Patea after a 2024 settlement without a finding of guilt, and the ATP ended a separate investigation into allegations by Olga Sharypova in 2023, citing insufficient evidence.
STAYING POWER
Zverev's 3-8 record against top-10 opponents this season may leave room for debate over whether the top ranking makes him the best player, but noted coach Patrick Mouratoglou said staying fit and sustaining excellence were skills in themselves.
For Zverev, who has managed Type 1 diabetes since childhood, durability has been a constant issue.
"A player is not only performing on court, it's also being healthy, managing your body," Mouratoglou said.
"If someone is never injured and others are often injured, the one that's not injured will probably end up having a higher ranking ... staying healthy when you're a professional athlete is a real skill."
Zverev said reaching number one late in his career had left him better prepared for the responsibility that accompanies the ranking, both as the face of the sport and the player everyone wants to beat.
"The number one position brings a lot with it," said Zverev, Germany's second men's world number one after Boris Becker in 1991.
"You have to be a good role model, do a lot of things right and on court that means more than returning and serving well. I still have Carlos and Jannik. Hopefully, I can keep competing with them over the next few years."

Source: Reuters

items.title: El oro cae por debajo de los US$4.000 la onza y se encamina a su segundo mes de pérdidas
items.author: Yihui Xie, Jack Ryan
items.summary: El metal precioso ha caído más del 4% en octubre, ya que la preocupación por la reanudación de los combates en Medio Oriente mantiene elevados los precios de la energía.
items.body: Bloomberg — El oro cayó por debajo de los US$4.000 la onza —encaminándose a su segundo mes consecutivo de pérdidas—, ya que el aumento de los precios del petróleo se sumó a las presiones inflacionarias y el desplome de las acciones tecnológicas aumentó el riesgo de que los inversores vendieran el metal para cubrir pérdidas. El oro cayó hasta un 1,4% el viernes, alcanzando los US$3.965,36 la onza, su nivel más bajo desde mediados de julio. La venta masiva de acciones tecnológicas continuó, mientras que la perspectiva de una nueva acción militar estadounidense contra Irán impulsó al crudo Brent a su nivel más alto desde abril, una presión inflacionaria que ha obligado a los inversores a replantearse sus expectativas sobre las tasas de interés. Ver más: Binance estima en US$6.300 millones el mayor hackeo de la historia de las criptomonedas El metal precioso ha caído más del 4% en octubre, ya que la preocupación por la reanudación de los combates en Medio Oriente mantiene elevados los precios de la energía. El miércoles, la Reserva Federal dejó abierta la posibilidad de una subida de tasas de interés antes de fin de año, y los operadores estiman una probabilidad del 70% de que se produzca en diciembre. El oro también sigue siendo vulnerable a las liquidaciones generalizadas en los mercados bursátiles. Las acciones tecnológicas lideraron las caídas bursátiles mundiales por segundo día consecutivo, ya que otra ronda de resultados decepcionantes aceleró la rotación fuera del sector de la inteligencia artificial. Esto se produjo tras la caída bursátil impulsada por la IA de la semana pasada, que contribuyó a arrastrar el oro a su nivel más bajo desde julio. Los operadores estaban atentos para ver si la caída de las acciones “se extiende a la sesión de hoy en Wall Street, lo que podría desencadenar un desapalancamiento más amplio y ventas impulsadas por la liquidez en todos los mercados”, dijo Ole Sloth Hansen, jefe de estrategia de materias primas de Saxo Bank AS. Ver más: Acciones tecnológicas caen tras desplome récord de Alphabet y reavivan temores por la IA Mientras tanto, la plata cayó más de un 3% hasta situarse cerca de los US$50 la onza, y acumulaba una caída superior al 16% en lo que va de mes. El metal precioso ha perdido todas las ganancias obtenidas desde principios de diciembre, cuando inició un espectacular repunte de dos meses hasta alcanzar un máximo superior a los US$120 la onza. “A pesar de que la plata ha entrado en territorio de sobreventa, persiste el riesgo de una mayor liquidación de posiciones largas y de ventas impulsadas por el impulso de los fondos centrados en el análisis técnico”, dijo Hansen, añadiendo que esto podría abrir la puerta a un movimiento hacia los US$40 la onza. La relación oro-plata ha alcanzado su nivel más alto desde diciembre, lo que significa que ahora se necesitan más onzas de plata para comprar la misma cantidad de oro. “Esta divergencia subraya la continua vulnerabilidad de la plata con respecto al oro, que sigue atrayendo la demanda de inversores menos sensibles a la evolución de las tasas de interés”, afirmó Hansen. El oro al contado cayó un 1,2% hasta los US$3.971,53 la onza a las 11:27 en Londres. La plata bajó un 3,3% hasta los US$50,42 la onza. El platino y el paladio también registraron descensos. El índice Bloomberg Dollar Spot , que mide el valor de la divisa estadounidense, retrocedió un 0,3%. --Con la colaboración de Preeti Soni. Lea más en Bloomberg.com

items.title: India orders top drugmaker to halt eye medicine production at plant over quality lapses
items.author: CNA
items.summary: Indian regulators have escalated action against India's largest drugmaker, Sun Pharma, barring ophthalmic drug production at its Assam factory until it submits a satisfactory compliance report.

India orders top drugmaker to halt eye medicine production at plant over quality lapses

Indian regulators have escalated action against India's largest drugmaker, Sun Pharma, barring ophthalmic drug production at its Assam factory until it submits a satisfactory compliance report.

FAST

HYDERABAD: Indian drug regulators ordered Sun Pharmaceutical Industries to stop manufacturing, selling and distributing ophthalmic products made at its Assam facility after finding failure in its quality management system, documents reviewed by Reuters showed.
The Central Drugs Standard Control Organisation and the office of Drugs Controller Assam ordered the shutdown on Aug 20 after a joint federal-state inspection of the facility identified lapses in the system meant to ensure product quality and safety, following Sun Pharma's move in July to voluntarily recall about 11 eye-care brands.
India's drug quality standards have come under increased scrutiny at home and overseas in recent years after locally made cough syrups were linked to the deaths of children in India and also in countries including Gambia and Uzbekistan.
The regulatory agencies' move marks an escalation of the action against Sun Pharma, India's biggest pharmaceutical firm, which will be unable to continue ophthalmic drug production at the Assam factory until it submits a satisfactory compliance report.

Sun Pharma said previously the site was expected to become one of its largest manufacturing hubs for sterile products in a business identified as a key global growth driver.
The regulators sought more information on the recall of 332 batches of ophthalmic suspension products - liquids used to treat eye conditions - the documents showed.
In an internal notice sent to stockists at the time, the company said it was withdrawing the products as a "precautionary measure." It remains unclear whether all of the recalled products were contaminated.
Sun Pharma did not publicly disclose details of the recall.
The company has submitted a compliance report in response to the order, which is being reviewed by the regulator, an official familiar with the matter told Reuters on condition of anonymity because they were not authorised to speak to the media.
Sun Pharma did not respond to Reuters' requests for comment on the Assam plant and the recall. The company says on its website it follows a single global quality standard.
RECALL COULD INVOLVE HUNDREDS OF THOUSANDS OF BOTTLES Some of the recalled products included Lotepred 1 per cent 5ml eye drops, Nepalact OD eye drops, Nepalact-Z, Brinzotim eye drops 5ml and Depopred 2ml. The eye drops are used to treat eye inflammation, infections and chronic eye diseases, according to doctors.
It is unclear whether these eye products were exported from India or whether any patients reported any adverse effects.

A man walks past a screen during a press conference announcing Sun Pharma's acquisition of US company, Organon in Mumbai, India, Apr 27, 2026. (Photo: Reuters/Francis Mascarenhas)

Reuters found that, based on the product packaging, most of the recalled products were manufactured at the Assam state facility in Kokjhar village. Reuters could not independently verify whether the 332 batches cited by regulators were related only to the 11 identified brands in the recall notice or included additional brands.
The affected batches could translate into hundreds of thousands of eye-drop bottles, according to industry experts, who declined to be identified because they were not authorised to speak publicly.
Ophthalmology contributes about 3 per cent of Sun Pharma's domestic revenue, according to its 2025-26 annual report. It is also one of its key areas for the United States.
The company reported a drop in second-quarter profit on Friday (Oct 30) weighed down by a one-time charge related to its acquisition of US-based Organon.
The eye product recall coincided with a patient-safety advisory issued in June by the All India Ophthalmological Society (AIOS), an independent body of eye specialists, warning that certain batches of Predmet eye drops appeared to be contaminated.
"There were some adverse cases of infections reported in patients who used Predmet and we got sealed bottles investigated and found it was contaminated," Santosh Honavar, a doctor and secretary of AIOS, told Reuters, adding that Sun Pharma had also recalled those Predmet drops.
Sun Pharma did not respond to Reuters' request for comment on the AIOS advisory.
The regulators issued a show-cause notice to Sun Pharma on Aug 10, citing the quality management system failures, the documents showed.
Dissatisfied with the company's response, the regulators ordered a halt to the manufacturing, sale and distribution of all ophthalmic products from the facility.
Indian regulators did not respond to Reuters' requests for comment. The agency did not issue a public health alert after the recall.
It is not the first time Sun Pharma's sterile manufacturing facilities have faced regulatory scrutiny. Last year, the US FDA halted the company's shipments from Gujarat's Halol plant after inspectors cited shortcomings in contamination controls.

Source: Reuters/cf

items.title: ＥＣＢ当局者、追加利上げの可能性指摘　物価・賃金上昇を警戒
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [フランクフルト ３０日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[フランクフルト ３０日 ロイター] - 欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）当局者は３０日、高インフレの抑制と賃金・物価の相互加速を防ぐため、追加利上げが必要になる可能性があるとの見方を示した。

ＥＣＢは前日の理事会で利上げを議論したが、エネルギー価格主導のインフレ急進が危険な二次的波及効果をまだ生んでいないとの判断に基づき、最終的に全会一致で据え置きを決めた。

３０日の当局者発言からは、利上げが先送りされたにすぎず、１２月の利上げがあり得ることを示した。

イタリア中央銀行のパネッタ総裁はローマで「物価上昇が家計や企業の期待や行動に定着して食い止めに代償を伴う賃金と物価の上昇スパイラルを引き起こすことを、金融政策は防ぐことができ、また防ぐべきだ」と指摘。「インフレ率が長期にわたり目標を上回る見通しで、リスクも上振れ方向にあることから、政策金利のさらなる引き上げが必要になる可能性がある」と述べた。

ＬＳＥＧのデータによると、市場は１２月の利上げ確率を約３分の２と見込んでいる。２０２６年にすでに実施された２回の利上げに加え、今後１年間に３回近くの利上げを予想している。

オーストリア中央銀行のコッハー総裁も３０日のブログ投稿でパネッタ氏と同様の見解を示し、「近い将来に状況が改善しなければ、金融政策を取り巻く環境からみて対応が必要になるだろう」と記し、「インフレリスクは明らかに高まった。ただ、時期尚早な行動も、何もせずに待つことも、物価安定を確保することにはならない」とした。

ユーロ圏の９月インフレ率は３．８％と、ＥＣＢの目標のほぼ２倍に達した。エネルギーコストの再急騰と食品価格の上昇により、今後数カ月に一段と加速する可能性がある。

ＥＣＢが３０日に公表した調査によると、インフレ率は２６・２７年に従来予想を上回るペースで加速し、目標に戻るのは２８年になる可能性がある。

エストニア中央銀行のカーシク総裁は「物価上昇が予想よりも速く、長期にわたって続くリスクは依然として大きい」と指摘。「したがって、金融市場がＥＣＢの追加利上げを見込んでいることは理解できる」と語った。

一方、パネッタ氏は慎重な姿勢も示し、ＥＣＢは「金融政策を段階的に調整する」際、最近の債券利回りの急上昇がすでに借り入れコストを押し上げていることを考慮すべきだと述べた。

Gone in 20 minutes: How the biggest heist in crypto history unfolded

"The attacker may not have stolen the vault key, they may have hijacked the system that tells the vault to release money," says a lawyer who works on crypto cases. 

Binance logo and hacker code are seen in this illustration taken October 30, 2026. REUTERS/Dado Ruvic/Illustration

SINGAPORE: Hackers stole US$6.3 billion from Binance , the world's biggest cryptocurrency exchange, in a record digital asset theft.
WHAT HAPPENED? About US$6.3 billion of cryptocurrencies were drained from wallets that Binance uses to process transactions, according to the exchange and expert analysis of blockchain records.
Binance said in a statement on X that it initially thought the attack involved a compromised laptop. 

"However, our subsequent investigation has uncovered additional points of breach," it added, without elaborating.
The exchange operates a secure asset fund for users, a US$1 billion bitcoin reserve designed to protect customers in the event of a security breach, according to its website.

Loading

Co-CEO Richard Teng said losses would be covered by the fund and company resources.
According to US blockchain analytics firm TRM Labs, the attackers compromised Binance's "signing infrastructure", which authorises transactions, allowing them to issue instructions that emptied the affected wallets.
The bulk of the heist unfolded in about 20 minutes, blockchain records show, beginning shortly after 8pm GMT (4am, Friday, Singapore time) on Thursday (Oct 29).
Once the funds were moved, the attackers raced to shift them beyond the reach of Binance counterparties and stablecoin issuers, which have frozen roughly half of the stolen assets.
An unusual feature of some cryptocurrencies, including major stablecoins such as Tether's USDT and Circle's USDC, is that their issuers can freeze them remotely.
"In layman's terms, the attacker may not have stolen the vault key, they may have hijacked the system that tells the vault to release money," said Joshua Chu, a Hong Kong lawyer who works on crypto cases. 
WHO IS BEHIND IT?  Several US blockchain analysis firms said the attack bears similarities to previous operations attributed to North Korean hackers.
Teng said Binance's investigation had not yet identified the attackers, while North Korea routinely denies involvement in cyberattacks and cryptocurrency thefts. North Korea's mission in Geneva and embassy in China did not immediately respond to requests for comment.
TRM said the breach shared characteristics with last year's attack on crypto exchange Bybit, which the FBI attributed to North Korean hackers. The firm said it was highly confident the same group was behind the Binance theft.
Chainalysis said funds stolen in an attack last month on Bitget were being mixed with proceeds from the Binance breach.

Related:

Hackers allegedly from North Korea steal US$6.3 billion from Binance in world's biggest crypto heist

WHERE'S THE MONEY? About half the stolen assets were stablecoins that have since been frozen by issuers including Tether, Circle, Ripple and World Liberty Financial, the Trump family's crypto venture.
That doesn't mean the coins will be returned to Binance, but it significantly limits the attackers' ability to convert them into cash.
TRM said some of the funds had already been posted as collateral to borrow ether and estimated that about US$2.4 billion worth of bitcoin and ether is beyond reach.
"No company issues bitcoin or ether and no company can freeze either one," said Patrick Tan, general counsel of ChainArgos, a blockchain intelligence firm in Singapore.
"The bitcoin and ether can be stopped only if the attacker sends them to a crypto-asset exchange or broker that is able and willing to freeze them, or if law enforcement obtains the private keys."
Market participants said the attackers would likely mix the stolen coins with other assets or use lesser known coins and exchanges to try to move the proceeds.
"The more time passes, the less likely they will be able to fold those funds into other exchanges or payment providers — they essentially get blacklisted," said Bernardo Brites, CEO of Trace Finance, a stablecoin infrastructure company.
"In reality a lot of the proceeds of hacks ... (can only be laundered) in the first few hours, but after that happens, you have a lot of different players who know those are marked funds ... and they usually sit there for years."
WHAT NEXT? The theft is the latest in a series of major digital asset breaches. Attackers stole US$2.9 billion of cryptocurrency across nearly 150 incidents last year, according to TRM Labs.
The attack has also rattled confidence in the sector. Cryptocurrencies fell on Friday and the total market value of stablecoins declined, suggesting investors were pulling money from digital assets.

Source: Reuters/rj

NEW DELHI: Six people were feared dead in a helicopter crash in the Indian Himalayan state of Uttarakhand on Friday (Oct 30), television channels reported, adding that bad weather was suspected to be the cause.
The helicopter was flying from Badrinath, a prominent pilgrimage destination for Hindus located in the mountains, to Dehradun city, carrying five passengers and a pilot, news agency ANI reported.
Uttarakhand Chief Minister Pushkar Singh Dhami said his office had received information about a helicopter crashing near a village in the Joshimath area.
A joint rescue operation was being carried out by the district administration, disaster management teams and troops in the region, Dhami said in a post on X.
TV channels said that rescue teams had rushed to the site of the crash and fire and smoke were visible there.

LONDON, Oct 30 : Binance is working with law enforcement around the world, including the Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) and the United States Secret Service (USSS), after hackers stole a record $6.3 billion from the platform, a person familiar with the situation told Reuters.

The USSS did not respond to a request for comment sent via email outside of US hours.

items.title: ユーロ圏ＧＤＰ、第3四半期速報は予想上回る0.4％増　失業率6.5％
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Balazs Koranyi

[フランクフルト ３０日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Balazs Koranyi

[フランクフルト ３０日 ロイター] -  欧州連合（ＥＵ）統計局（ユーロスタット）が３０日発表した第３・四半期のユーロ圏域内総生産（ＧＤＰ）速報値は、前期比０．４％増と、市場予想を上回った。投資と消費が堅調で、エネルギー高の逆風にもかかわらず底堅さを示したが、借り入れコストの急上昇と急速なインフレが先行きに影を落としている。 

非常に高い伸びとなった第２・四半期の０．６％から減速したものの、ロイターがまとめたエコノミスト予想の０．２％を上回った。

前年同期比では１．３％増と、予想の１．１％を上回った。潜在成長率とおおむね同水準だった。

人工知能（ＡＩ）、防衛、インフラへの多額の支出が投資を押し上げ、堅調な外需が産業を支えた。家計も高水準にある貯蓄率を引き下げながら消費を続けた。

国別では、ドイツが前期比０．２％増、スペインとオランダがそれぞれ０．６％増だった。イタリアは横ばいで、フランスは０．１％のマイナス成長となった。

ユーロ圏の成長率は米国の半分にも満たないが、イラン戦争が始まった後に示された悲観的な予測をなお大幅に上回っている。

アイルランドの前期比５．５％という突出した伸びにユーロ圏全体の成長率が押し上げられた面もある。

ユーロ圏の主要国の大半で１０月に物価上昇が加速しており、域内全体の前年比インフレ率は３．９％以上に跳ね上がる可能性がある。ＥＣＢの目標である２％を大幅に上回る水準だ。こうした数字になれば、すでに市場で広がっている１２月の追加利上げ観測が一段と強まる。

追加利上げは成長をさらに抑制するが、欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）が３０日に公表した調査では、インフレ期待が大幅に上昇しており物価上昇率が目標に戻るのは２８年になる可能性が示された。ＥＣＢ当局者も追加利上げの可能性を指摘した。 

しかし経済指標は高インフレがまだ二次的波及効果を生んでいないことを示している。労働市場が比較的軟調なためとみられる。

８月の失業率は６．５％で横ばいだった。ただ、過去１年の大半にわたり緩やかに上昇しており、２４年終盤に記録した過去最低の６．２％を上回っている。

Oct 30 : Hackers stole $6.3 billion from Binance in the world's biggest crypto heist, putting a spotlight on how cryptocurrency exchanges insure their digital assets against theft and cyberattacks.
But insurance protection is far from uniform. Coverage depends on how assets are stored, how hackers gain access and the specific terms of the policy.
Limited regulation and volatile crypto prices have long made insurers wary of the sector, despite growing demand for protection against digital asset theft and claims against company executives.
While both crime and demand for protection have tracked cryptocurrencies' meteoric rise, underwriting such risks remains a niche business offered largely by specialist insurers in the Lloyd's market and in Bermuda.

WHAT IS DIGITAL ASSET INSURANCE?
Digital asset insurance is a range of policies designed to protect cryptocurrency exchanges, custodians and other companies operating in the sector against financial losses arising from the theft of digital assets, cyberattacks, technology failures and other business risks.
Unlike traditional insurance, these policies are tailored to risks associated with blockchain technology, including the theft or loss of private keys, wallet security breaches, smart contract vulnerabilities and failures in digital asset custody.
The global crypto insurance market was valued at $9.37 billion in 2025 and is projected to reach $184.98 billion by 2033, according to Data Bridge Market Research.
The research firm cited growing institutional adoption of cryptocurrencies and rising incidents of cyberattacks and digital asset theft among the factors driving demand.
Coverage can include several types of policies:
• Crime insurance for theft, social engineering and scams
• Cyber liability for breaches, hacks and regulatory response
• Errors and omissions insurance for software bugs, smart contract failures
• Directors and officers insurance for lawsuits targeting executives
• Technology liability for infrastructure providers
HOW ARE LOSSES COVERED?
When a crypto exchange suffers a hack, losses can be covered through a combination of insurance payouts, the company's own capital and emergency funds set aside to compensate customers.
The extent of insurance coverage depends on the policies held by the exchange, including their limits, deductibles and exclusions. Where losses exceed the insured amount, the company must rely on its own financial resources or other recovery arrangements to meet its obligations.
Some exchanges also maintain reserve funds to reimburse customers following security breaches. Binance established the Secure Asset Fund for Users (SAFU) in July 2018 as an emergency reserve to protect users in extreme cases, such as security breaches or platform-level incidents.
As of 2026, the SAFU fund holds crypto assets worth roughly $1 billion, entirely in bitcoin, according to Binance's website. The company did not immediately respond to Reuters' request for comment on its insurance coverage.
WHAT CAN PREVENT AN INSURANCE PAYOUT?
Exclusions that allow insurers to deny certain claims are common in policies covering digital assets as well as the personal liabilities of directors and officers at cryptocurrency companies. These can limit the scope of protection available to companies and make it harder for them to secure coverage.
Common exclusions in these policies include value fluctuations, fraudulent acts by the policyholder and unsecured or negligent key management.
DO TRADITIONAL CRIME AND CYBER INSURANCE POLICIES COVER CRYPTO?
Most standard crime insurance policies do not cover cryptocurrency losses, as they were originally designed to protect physical property such as cash, securities and precious metals.
Traditional cyber liability policies also do not always cover the value of digital assets stolen in a hack. While cyber policies can cover both first-party losses and third-party liabilities, including forensic investigations, customer notifications and legal expenses, they generally exclude the loss or transfer of funds.
As a result, standalone cyber policies typically do not cover the full value of stolen cryptocurrency unless specific digital asset coverage has been added.
HOW DO INSURERS ASSESS CRYPTO THEFT CLAIMS?
Insurers examine how a breach occurred, which systems were compromised and whether the resulting loss falls within the policy's coverage.
They may also assess whether the exchange followed required security procedures, including controls over private keys, wallet access and transaction approvals.
The distinction between an external hacker stealing credentials and an employee deliberately transferring assets can determine whether a crime or cyber insurance policy covers the loss.

Source: Reuters

Oct 30 : Shares of Reddit tumbled 23 per cent in premarket trading on Friday after it warned Google's growing use of AI in search was hurting referral traffic and could shrink its user base, offering fresh evidence of AI-driven disruption.
Pinterest also fell 7.28 per cent after forecasting fourth-quarter revenue below Wall Street estimates, as a pullback by cross-border sellers in Europe weighed on its outlook.
Here are more details:
• Reddit's warning highlights how Google's shift toward AI-powered search, which can answer queries directly, is disrupting the flow of traffic to websites that have traditionally relied on the search engine for users

• Total daily active unique visitors could fall by a low double-digit percentage in the fourth quarter from about 130 million if referral traffic continues to fall, Reddit said
• JPMorgan analysts said the expansion of Google's AI Overviews and AI Mode, along with changes to how machine-translated content is ranked, has pushed search traffic down
• A reset in expectations is appropriate and the near-term outlook is increasingly clouded, said Piper Sandler analysts
• Meanwhile, Reddit said in a filing it had extended its cloud services agreements with Amazon Web Services and Google through 2029, committing to spend $880 million and $580 million, respectively, over three years
• Pinterest's third-quarter revenue of $1.17 billion missed analysts' estimates of $1.21 billion, according to data compiled by LSEG
• Pinterest forecast fourth-quarter revenue of $1.425 billion to $1.475 billion, below Wall Street estimates
• RBC analysts said changes to the EU's de minimis exemption hit cross-border sellers sooner and harder than expected, leaving Pinterest's European revenue flat
• Reddit had fallen about 44 per cent this year and Pinterest about 23 per cent through Thursday's close
• If current losses hold, Reddit is set to lose $5.7 billion in market value and Pinterest more than $800 million

Oct 30 : Hong Kong flagship carrier Cathay Pacific Airways said on Friday a data security breach at the Spanish software provider Amadeus affected around 53,000 bookings, though its own systems and operations were unaffected.
Cathay joins other airlines, including Japan Airlines and South Korea's Asiana Airlines, that recently flagged customer data was compromised in the Amadeus breach.
• The October 28 breach included booking reference, passenger name and flight details in most cases, but additional personal information was compromised in a smaller subset of cases, Cathay Pacific said
• Cathay Pacific said the breach affected bookings from August 2023 to September, citing Amadeus data, and added there was "no evidence that financial or payment information was accessed"

FAST

Oct 30 : Intel tumbled 29 per cent on Friday and was on track for its sharpest one-day decline, deepening a broader retreat in technology stocks as investors grew increasingly wary of weakening PC demand and the vast spending required to build out AI infrastructure.
The steep fall put the US chipmaker on track to shed more than $137 billion in market value, underscoring the challenges facing CEO Lip-Bu Tan's turnaround as a prolonged PC slump offsets heavy investments in AI and manufacturing expansion.
Semiconductor stocks, including Advanced Micro Devices, Arm Holdings, Qualcomm, Nvidia, Broadcom and Micron, fell between 2 per cent and 10 per cent.
"The market is in a sell first, ask questions later mood right now, and Intel's warning has given investors an easy excuse to take some money off the table across chip stocks," said Matt Britzman, senior equity analyst, Hargreaves Lansdown.

The selloff spread to server makers, reflecting investor caution toward companies tied to the semiconductor and AI infrastructure supply chain.
Shares of server makers Dell Technologies, Hewlett Packard Enterprise and Super Micro Computer fell between 6 per cent and 10 per cent.
The STOXX Europe 600 Technology Index fell 2 per cent, with sector heavyweight ASML shedding 4.6 per cent. US-listed shares of TSMC, the world's largest contract chipmaker, fell 3.3 per cent.
Intel forecast fourth-quarter revenue of $15 billion to $16 billion, below analysts' average estimate of $17.07 billion, according to data compiled by LSEG.
Finance chief David Zinsner also said Intel does not expect positive cash flow this year.
MEMORY CRUNCH BITES
Higher memory prices, driven by suppliers shifting capacity toward AI-focused high-bandwidth memory chips, are raising PC costs and weighing on already weak consumer demand.
PC chips accounted for roughly half of Intel's third-quarter revenue, and the company expects sales from the segment to decline more than 20 per cent sequentially this quarter after a 5 per cent drop in the September period.
"It will be important to see if Intel can expand the highly profitable Xeon product supply to help offset this developing weakness in PC," said Brian Mulberry, chief market strategist at Zacks Investment Management.
"Bottom line, weaker sales volumes, higher manufacturing costs, and an out-of-cycle product mix is a recipe for the stock to decline over the near term as future earnings are under a lot of pressure."

Source: Reuters

items.title: 中国軍、スカボロー礁で戦闘即応パトロール　フィリピンに対抗
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [北京 ３０日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[北京 ３０日 ロイター] - 中国軍は３０日、南シナ海で中国とフィリピンの長年の対立の火種となっているスカボロー礁（中国名・黄岩島）周辺で、海空軍が戦闘即応パトロールを実施したと発表した。

人民解放軍南部戦区は声明で、パトロールは「フィリピンによる権益侵害と挑発行為への必要な対抗措置」だとし、１０月に入ってこうしたパトロールを強化していると説明した。

「こうしたパトロールは関連海域・空域の管理と統制をさらに強化することを目的としており、あらゆる権益侵害や挑発行為に対処する有効な対抗措置となる」と述べた。

中国海警局も３０日、スカボロー礁周辺の海域で法執行のためのパトロールを別途実施し、「フィリピンによる権益侵害と挑発行為への必要な対抗措置」だとした。

中国軍と中国海警局はともに、フィリピンのどの行動を指しているのか、詳細を明らかにしなかった。

items.title: 中国・スイス首脳、貿易協定改定を歓迎　保護主義の流れに逆行
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [北京 ３０日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[北京 ３０日 ロイター] - 中国の習近平国家主席とスイスのパルムラン大統領は３０日、両国の貿易協定の改定を歓迎した。世界的に保護主義が広がる中、流れに逆行する動きとなる。

協定は３０日に署名される予定で、スイスに対し中国市場への参入を異例の水準まで自由化する。

パルムラン氏は「両国関係の新たな一歩であり、交渉の成果を誇ってよいと思う。企業や他の関係者の具体的な期待に応えた」と述べた。両国の外相による次回の戦略対話を年内に開きたいとの意向も示した。

習氏は、今回の協定は開かれた協力関係を守る政治的勇気と責任感を示すものだと評価した。両国が力を合わせれば、中国と欧州の貿易協力や世界経済の発展に、より大きな確実性をもたらすことができると述べた。
